checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy
must.why: Spelled correctly in navy rounded serif.

must.item: Gold crescent moon above the name
must.why: Croissant-shaped golden crescent sits above the text, with crumbs.
Opaque cream background baked in; the image is a flat JPG-like render with no transparency.

must.item: Edges intact, no halos or missing strokes
must.why: Edges are clean, with no visible halos or broken letters.

faults.what: Background is opaque cream, not transparent, so the logo can't be placed over other colors.
The croissant is rendered with realistic shading and texture rather than the flat style described; it reads as a croissant more than a moon.

summary: A clean, correctly spelled Mooncrumb logo with a golden croissant-crescent above navy text, but it has an opaque cream background instead of transparency.
